svg.title: Keypress heatmap: QWERTY, Colemak, Colemak-DH (matrix)
svg.desc: Three-row, ten-column key grids for QWERTY, Colemak, Colemak-DH (matrix), each shaded by how often the key is pressed over the same body of text. On QWERTY, 33 percent of keypresses land on the home row, 26 percent in the two inner columns that an index finger reaches by splaying sideways, and 4.6 percent are same-finger bigrams. On Colemak, 70 percent of keypresses land on the home row, 13 percent in the two inner columns that an index finger reaches by splaying sideways, and 1.3 percent are same-finger bigrams. On Colemak-DH (matrix), 67 percent of keypresses land on the home row, 9 percent in the two inner columns that an index finger reaches by splaying sideways, and 1.3 percent are same-finger bigrams.
